name: SWIFT Heist
desc: A financial crime involving the SWIFT banking network.

acts.d: Suspected that phishing emails were sent to employees at Bangladesh Bank which dropped malware.
Suspected that attackers gained access by exploiting weakness in a new electronic payment system (real time gross settlement).
Credentials stolen for SWIFT operator at Bangladesh Bank.
Attackers deleted files associated with SWIFT software to prevent employees from seeing the SWIFT messages
Attackers used malware to disable printer, which prevented SWIFT acknowledgement messages being printed out for manual review
